name: pfs_domain_contacts
description: List identifiers and verification status for your saved PFS registration contacts. Create or edit contacts in the signed-in SEUS domain console; never enter contact information into chat.

name: list_my_posts
description: List the authenticated user's posts (articles and short posts), newest first.

name: get_post
description: Get one post's full markdown content by id. The caller's own posts are readable in any lifecycle state; other people's posts only when published and visible to the caller (public, or followers-only if the caller follows the author).

name: create_article
description: Create a new article (markdown) owned by the authenticated user. publishNow=false saves a draft; otherwise the article enters the same submit/review pipeline as the web editor (pre-submit keyword gate → pending_review → the moderation plugin publishes or queues review).

boardId.description: Board to submit to (required when publishNow; must be a board created by the admins)

topics.description: Official topic names of that board (1-3 when publishNow); unknown names are ignored. Topics are admin-created only

announce.description: Admin tokens only: also publish as a site-wide announcement (every user gets a system notification when it publishes). Non-admin tokens are rejected.

name: update_post
description: Update an existing post's title/content/summary (must be owned by the caller). Editing a published post re-enters the moderation pipeline (status goes back to pending_review, same as the web editor).

name: delete_post
description: Move one of the authenticated user's posts to the recycle bin (soft delete, restorable from the web UI). Posts already in the recycle bin are reported as not found.

name: search_posts
description: Search published posts across the platform by keyword (title, summary, body and their translations in any site language; whitespace-separated terms are AND-combined).

name: get_feed
description: Browse the community feed (recent published public posts and short posts).

name: list_my_media
description: List the authenticated user's media library (WebP images).

name: delete_media
description: Delete a media file from the authenticated user's library (removes the library row and the underlying file).

name: list_post_comments
description: List comments on a post (only comments the caller may see).

name: get_profile
description: Get the authenticated user's profile.

name: get_stats
description: Get the authenticated user's content statistics.

name: list_boards
description: List active community boards with their posting policy. Use it to find the boardId required by create_article.

name: list_board_topics
description: List the active official topics of one board (by slug). The candidates for create_article's topics argument (1-3 must belong to the submitted board).

name: domains_list
description: List the authenticated user's subdomains with optional search/filter/sort. By default released domains are not listed (2026-10-17: paid deletions and expiry releases leave the default view); pass status="released" to list them. Returns domain DTOs (fqdn, status, nameservers, DNSSEC state, expiry) and the total count.

q.description: fuzzy match on label (unicode or ASCII form)

name: domains_suffixes
description: List the public suffix catalog open for registration (per-suffix label length rules, price tiers in points, premium length tiers, DNSSEC availability, deletePrice for paid deletion: null = deletion closed, 0 = free, positive = one-off fee) plus the registration meta: whether registration is currently enabled, the per-transaction year limit, the grace period (days) and the points unit (unitName/unit). Purchasable terms are exactly the terms configured in priceTiers for every label; premium pricing changes the price (unit price x years), not the term set.

name: domains_check
description: Check whether a label is available for registration under a suffix (no side effects). Reserved labels report available=false with reason="reserved"; the provider-side check is best-effort (providerChecked=false means the local registry answer only). The result carries pricing: { price, premium } — the 1-year reference price and whether the label hits a premium length tier.

label.description: label to register (unicode or ASCII form)

name: domains_get
description: Get the authenticated user's domain by ID, with its expiration, nameservers, DNSSEC, and current delegation sync state.

name: domain_register
description: Register a PFS domain using an existing saved registration contact. First check availability, the registration term and any required existing SEUS points. Ask the user to confirm the exact operation and explicitly accept the registration terms and acceptable-use policy. The verified SEUS account, balance, and registration policy are checked by the server. Do not collect inline contact details, offer points purchases, or redirect to checkout.

label.description: label to register (unicode or ASCII form)

years.description: registration term in years (1-3, site policy cap)

dsRecords.description: DS records for DNSSEC. Only allowed when dnssecEnabled=true (cleared automatically when DNSSEC is off).

contactId.description: Saved registration contact identifier returned by pfs_domain_contacts.

acceptRegistrationTerms.description: True only after the user explicitly accepts https://publicfreesuffix.org/legal/registration-agreement/.

acceptAcceptableUsePolicy.description: True only after the user explicitly accepts https://publicfreesuffix.org/legal/acceptable-use-policy/.

name: domain_update_ns
description: Update the desired delegation state (nameservers / DNSSEC / DS records) of one of the caller's active domains. Omitted fields keep their current value; at least one field is required. Disabling DNSSEC clears all DS records. The change is queued for provider sync (idempotent convergence); expired domains cannot be updated.

dsRecords.description: DS records for DNSSEC. Only allowed when dnssecEnabled=true (cleared automatically when DNSSEC is off).

name: domain_renew
description: Renew one of the caller's domains by a number of months (1-36) and charge points, billed pro-rata from the annual price: price = round(annualPrice x months / 12). Renewal is available at any time and can be repeated continuously; the only limit is that total validity may never exceed 3 years (36 months) from now, so the allowed months shrink as remaining validity grows. Renewing inside the grace period revives an expired domain. Pass requestId (any uuid) to make retries idempotent: the same requestId never double-charges or double-extends. Pass expectedPrice (the price you showed the user) to fail with renew_price_changed instead of charging when the suffix pricing changed in the meantime.

months.description: renewal term in months, integer 1-36, billed pro-rata from the annual price

requestId.description: client intent idempotency key for retries

expectedPrice.description: price previously quoted to the user; the call fails with renew_price_changed when the computed price differs

name: dns_zones
description: List your DNS hosting zones (per-zone record counts, sync status, delegation state). Read-only.

name: dns_zone_get
description: Get one DNS zone panel: zone summary (status, driver, sync state, DNSSEC) plus all records. Read-only; non-owned ids return 404.

name: dns_zone_create
description: Create a DNS hosting zone for a site-registered domain (domainId) or an external domain (externalFqdn, exactly one of the two). Mutating; consumes the per-user zone quota; the zone is provisioned on a hosting node and delegation is wired automatically for site domains.

name: dns_zone_delete
description: Delete a DNS hosting zone (destructive, irreversible): resolution stops immediately and all records are wiped from the node and the site. The domain itself is unaffected; re-add hosting anytime via dns_zone_create.

name: dns_record_create
description: Create a DNS record (A/AAAA/CNAME/ALIAS/MX/TXT/SRV/CAA/PTR/SVCB/HTTPS/TLSA/DNAME) in your zone. Mutating; conflicts (CNAME coexistence), per-zone record quota and per-type validation are enforced server-side.

name: dns_record_update
description: Update one of your DNS records (type/name/content/ttl/disabled/meta; at least one field). Mutating. Suffix-level IDN resolution restrictions apply the same way as creation (dns_record_idn_disabled).

name: dns_record_delete
description: Delete one of your DNS records. Mutating.

name: dns_records_import
description: Bulk-import records from an RFC 1035 zone file (max 256 KB). System records (SOA/NS/DS/DNSSEC) are skipped; capacity/conflict warnings are reported per line without aborting the batch. Mutating.

name: dns_zone_dnssec
description: Enable or disable DNSSEC signing for your zone (DS propagation to the parent delegation is handled server-side). Mutating.

name: dns_zone_verify
description: Check public NS delegation for a pending (external) zone and activate it when delegation is satisfied. Idempotent; returns the new status.

name: dns_zone_export
description: Export your zone as an RFC 1035 zone file. Read-only.

name: dns_events
description: Recent activity timeline of your zone (create/record/dnssec/billing... events, newest first). Read-only.

name: dns_pricing
description: DNS hosting plan disclosure: monthly price, days remaining this month, prorated first-month estimate, zone quota usage. Read-only.

name: domain_transfer_create_code
description: Generate a transfer code for one of the caller's active domains. The plaintext code is returned exactly once in this response (only its hash is stored) and is also emailed to the owner. Store it now. Regenerating revokes the previous code and cancels its pending incoming transfer requests. Code expires in 7 days.

name: domain_transfer_revoke_code
description: Revoke a domain's active transfer code and cancel its pending transfer requests (recipient is notified). Idempotent: revoking when no active code exists succeeds silently.

name: domain_transfer_request
description: Request the transfer of a domain to the caller using a transfer code obtained from its current owner. After the transfer completes the domain is hosted on the platform's managed DNS (custom nameservers are not accepted during transfers). An OTP is emailed to the current owner. The caller must ask them for it (the OTP never appears in tool output or logs). Wrong codes consume attempts and lock the code after 5 failures; the transfer completes only via domain_transfer_confirm.

fqdn.description: full domain to transfer (unicode or ASCII form)

code.description: transfer code from the current owner (XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX)

name: domain_transfer_resend_otp
description: Resend the transfer OTP to the current owner's email (recipient's own pending request only). Resending issues a new OTP, resets its 10-minute TTL and clears the attempt counter.

name: domain_transfer_confirm
description: Complete a domain transfer by submitting the 6-digit OTP the current owner received by email. On success the domain changes ownership immediately, lands on the platform's managed DNS hosting, and DNSSEC is cleared (trust anchors do not survive a transfer). Wrong/expired OTPs consume attempts; the request locks after 5 failures.

otp.description: 6-digit code from the current owner's email

name: domain_transfer_my_requests
description: List the caller's pending incoming transfer requests (domains being transferred to them, awaiting OTP confirmation).

name: domain_delete
description: Permanently delete (paid release of) one of the caller's domains: the label is released for anyone to re-register immediately, the delegation is withdrawn from the authoritative DNS and its hosted DNS zones are torn down. Irreversible. The suffix must have a deletion price configured (deletePrice in domains_suffixes: null = deletion closed, 0 = free, positive = one-off charge returned together with the new balance). Only active or expired (grace period) domains can be deleted; domains under admin enforcement or with an active transfer are rejected. API tokens act as their own holding factor, so the web session 2FA gate does not apply over MCP.

name: pfs_whois
description: Look up PFS WHOIS facts for one full domain name. Only PFS-managed suffixes are supported. Returns registration state and public domain details without contact information.

name: pfs_ssl_list
description: List certificate orders and available certificate authorities for one owned DNS zone. Results include issuance stage and expiration, without certificate files or private keys.

zoneId.description: DNS zone id returned by dns_zones.

name: pfs_ssl_order
description: Request certificate issuance for an owned zone. Creates an order and may add temporary DNS challenge records. Check the supported CA and confirm the requested names before submitting.

zoneId.description: DNS zone id returned by dns_zones.

name: pfs_ssl_renew
description: Queue a manual renewal of an active certificate owned by the caller. The current certificate may be replaced after renewal succeeds.

name: pfs_ssl_auto_renew
description: Change whether an owned certificate renews automatically. Disabling renewal can cause the certificate to expire.

name: pfs_hosting_list
description: List the caller's free hosting instances and quota, with their status and DNS binding.

name: pfs_hosting_get
description: Read management and DNS binding status for one owned hosting instance.

instanceId.description: Hosting instance id returned by pfs_hosting_list.

name: pfs_hosting_usage
description: Read provider-reported usage for one owned hosting instance. Usage may be temporarily unavailable.

instanceId.description: Hosting instance id returned by pfs_hosting_list.

name: pfs_hosting_precheck
description: Check free hosting eligibility and quota for one owned registered domain or a hostname in an external zone. Reports DNS conflicts without changing records.

name: pfs_hosting_create
description: Queue free hosting for one owned registered domain or a hostname in an external zone. Consumes free quota and may add DNS records. Existing conflicts require manual resolution.

name: pfs_hosting_retry_bind
description: Retry the domain binding of one owned active hosting instance. This may add or update DNS records managed by the hosting integration.

instanceId.description: Hosting instance id returned by pfs_hosting_list.

name: pfs_hosting_suspend
description: Suspend one owned hosting instance. This interrupts service for the website and should only be done after the user confirms the exact instance.

instanceId.description: Hosting instance id returned by pfs_hosting_list.

name: pfs_hosting_resume
description: Resume service for one owned suspended hosting instance.

instanceId.description: Hosting instance id returned by pfs_hosting_list.

name: pfs_hosting_ssl_list
description: View certificates and recent deployment status for one owned hosting instance. Does not query live DNS or return certificate files.

instanceId.description: Hosting instance id returned by pfs_hosting_list.

name: pfs_hosting_ssl_install
description: Queue deployment of an existing compatible certificate on an owned hosting instance. This can replace the active certificate and change automatic renewal settings.

instanceId.description: Hosting instance id returned by pfs_hosting_list.

name: pfs_show_resources
description: Display verified PFS resource rows or a proposed change as a searchable table. Choose localized column labels. Supply only the fields the user asked to see, without secrets or contact details.
